name: HostMyApple

modes.label: macOS Tahoe cloud VPS (virtualized macOS), monthly

sizes.name: Cloud Lite: 4 vCPU, 3 GB, 60 GB SSD
Cloud Basic: 4 vCPU, 4 GB, 80 GB SSD
Cloud Pro: 4 vCPU, 5 GB, 100 GB SSD
Cloud Max: 6 vCPU, 6 GB, 100 GB SSD

modes.note: Virtual Mac servers with dedicated IP, remote desktop, SSH, full admin, unlimited bandwidth (1000 Mbps). Max 6 GB RAM, so a 4 vCPU / 8 GiB workload does not fit. CloudApp editions (BlueBubbles/Beeper, 3 GB) are $24.99 too.

modes.label: Dedicated Mac mini, monthly

sizes.name: Mac mini M6, 16 GB, 256 GB (11 available)
Mac mini M6, 32 GB, 256 GB (2 available)
Mac Studio M5 Max 4.6 GHz, 64 GB, 512 GB (portal only, 1 available)

modes.note: Whole Mac mini, full root, dedicated IP, unlimited bandwidth. Core counts not listed; M1 (8-core) and M4 (10-core) are fixed by the chip, M6 and the Intel i7 are left null. Add-on external NVMe SSD 1 TB $30, 2 TB $60, 4 TB $125 per month; no setup fee; monthly billing cycle only (annual on request after 90 days).
modes.stock_note: few units per model in stock (store showed 1-11 available on 2026-09-29)

caveats: VPS host hardware and VMs-per-host not disclosed. A multi-tenant macOS VPS sits uneasily with the Apple SLA requirement that a lessee gets "sole and exclusive use" of the leased Mac (licensing grey zone).
providers/hostmyapple.json said VPS up to 64 GB and dedicated pricing unpublished; live pages show VPS 3-6 GB ($24.99-$54.99) and dedicated $59.99-$179.99.
No provisioning or agent API found; access via NoMachine / ARD / VNC / SSH.
Apple macOS SLA: leasing a Mac requires a minimum lease of 24 consecutive hours with sole use by the lessee, and allows at most 2 additional macOS VMs per Mac.

Refund only within the first 14 days ('Refund requests must be submitted within fourteen (14) calendar days'); crypto payments non-refundable; late payments 1.5%/month; remote hands $100/h (30-min increments) or $160/h after hours; 'Excessive usage may result in additional fees' despite 'Unlimited Bandwidth'. Annual billing only after 90 days active (discount not stated). VPS is VMware-based (FAQ: '/Library/Application Support/VMware Tools/').

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: How do I backup the data from my macOS VPS or Dedicated Server? We recommend backing up your data using any number of popular services such as DropBox or Backblaze.
snapshot_auto.note: No snapshot or backup product at all; the provider points customers to third-party backup services. Disk simply persists (monthly always-on VPS / dedicated Mac).

snapshot_on_demand.quote: For backups we highly recommend either Backblaze (backblaze.com) or DropBox (Dropbox.com) While we take many precautions to secure your data, we always highly recommend performing regular backups :)
snapshot_on_demand.note: No customer-facing snapshot/checkpoint feature. Only a support-ticket reset to the stock image: 'We can reset your VPS image back to it's original state at any time. For more information please submit a ticket'.

harness_api.quote: We recommend NoMachine, Apple Remote Desktop, or VNC. ... For those users that wish to connect via terminal, SSH is enabled on all servers by default.
harness_api.note: No API/SDK/CLI of any kind; only a WHMCS customer portal (reboot, cancel). Agents would have to be driven over SSH/VNC.

guest_firewall.quote: In macOS Sequoia, Apple still uses Packet Filter (PF) to control network traffic. Here’s how to open a port manually:
guest_firewall.note: macOS pf (not nftables/iptables) with 'Full Root Access' on every plan; VPS is a full VMware VM, dedicated plans are bare-metal Mac minis. Official blog walks through pf rules, so derived with medium confidence.

secret_proxy.quote: HostMyApple is a Mac Virtual Private Server (VPS) service. We provide users with a Mac OS X hosted system it in our amazing datacenter.
secret_proxy.note: No secrets-injection/HTTP-proxy feature exists anywhere in the docs, FAQ, or portal; it is a plain VPS/dedicated-server host where any credentials would simply live on the machine.

isolation.quote: How do I change the display resolution on my macOS VPS? Open Terminal and navigate to the directory: /Library/Application Support/VMware Tools/
isolation.note: VPS tier is virtualized macOS (VMware Tools present inside the guest, per FAQ) — closest fit to the 'apple-vm' bucket for virtualized macOS. The separate 'dedicated' mode is a whole physical Mac mini/Studio (bare-metal), not virtualized; the two modes differ.

image_oci.quote: HostMyApple is the #1 provider of macOS Tahoe cloud servers... All Mac VPS cloud servers come with a dedicated IP address with Remote Desktop, SSH and full Administrator access.
image_oci.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — this is a macOS VPS/dedicated-server host (fixed stock macOS image per plan), not an OCI/container image runtime.

docker_inside.quote: What applications or services can I run on my macOS Cloud Server? You can run any application or service you wish!... MAMP (macOS with Apache, MySQL, PHP, Pearl, Python), Database services such as MySQL, a game server.... Anything you wish!
docker_inside.note: Docker/containers are never mentioned in the FAQ, feature lists, or use-case pages, even though full root/admin access is granted. Not documented as offered.

nested_virt.quote: Open Terminal and navigate to the directory: /Library/Application Support/VMware Tools/
nested_virt.note: VPS tier itself runs as a VMware guest; no mention anywhere of nested virtualization/hypervisor passthrough (/dev/kvm equivalent) being exposed inside the guest. Not documented as offered.

anti_bot.quote: HostMyApple is the #1 provider of macOS Tahoe cloud servers and the fastest! ... Access your macOS Virtual desktop anytime, anywhere from any device!
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — plain macOS VPS/dedicated-server hosting, not a browser-automation/scraping product.

captcha_solving.quote: HostMyApple is the #1 provider of macOS Tahoe cloud servers and the fastest! ... Access your macOS Virtual desktop anytime, anywhere from any device!
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — plain macOS VPS/dedicated-server hosting, not a CAPTCHA/automation product.

egress_ip_type.quote: Do I get my own IP address? Yes, each macOS VPS and dedicated server hosted with us will have its own static IP address.
egress_ip_type.note: Servers sit in HostMyApple's own datacenters (Atlanta, Denver, Amsterdam) and each gets a dedicated static IP — datacenter-class, not residential/mobile.

volume_attach.quote: Is it possible to upgrade to a better VPS package with more RAM / Disk space at a later time? Yes, Simply open a ticket with support and specify which package you would like to upgrade to and we will schedule the upgrade at your convenience.
volume_attach.note: Disk capacity is a fixed per-plan attribute changed only by migrating to a bigger plan via support ticket; current live pricing/FAQ pages show no customer-facing 'attach an extra volume' feature.

volume_shared.quote: All Mac VPS cloud servers come with a dedicated IP address with Remote Desktop, SSH and full Administrator access.
volume_shared.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — each VPS/dedicated Mac is a single-tenant machine with its own disk; no mention of a volume mountable by multiple machines at once.

live_resize.quote: Is it possible to upgrade to a better VPS package with more RAM / Disk space at a later time? Yes, Simply open a ticket with support and specify which package you would like to upgrade to and we will schedule the upgrade at your convenience.
live_resize.note: Resizing requires a support ticket and a scheduled migration/downtime to a different plan, not an in-place API-driven resize of a running machine.

own_agent_api.quote: How do I control my macOS Cloud Server? ... We recommend NoMachine, Apple Remote Desktop, or VNC. ... For those users that wish to connect via terminal, SSH is enabled on all servers by default.
own_agent_api.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — access is only via remote-desktop tools, SSH, and a WHMCS billing/support portal; no first-party task/browser/computer-use agent API exists.

mcp_server.quote: How do I control my macOS Cloud Server? ... We recommend NoMachine, Apple Remote Desktop, or VNC.
mcp_server.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no provisioning/control API of any kind is published, let alone an MCP server.

lang_python.quote: Develop with Ruby On Rails, Python and more! Our macOS VPS's provide access to native development tools for many scripts and languages such as Pearl, Ruby On Rails, Python and more!
lang_python.note: Provider explicitly markets native Python availability on the VPS/dedicated macOS servers.

lang_node.quote: High-Performance Web Hosting & Backend Development Deploy fast, reliable web applications using Node.js, Django, Ruby on Rails, or Laravel on a dedicated macOS cloud server.
lang_node.note: Provider explicitly markets Node.js-based web app deployment on the macOS servers.

ingress_rules.quote: All Mac VPS cloud servers come with a dedicated IP address with Remote Desktop, SSH and full Administrator access.
ingress_rules.note: No provider-side ingress control feature (private/auth URLs, IP allowlists, security groups) is documented; customers only get a dedicated public IP and would configure macOS's own pf firewall themselves (guest_firewall).

egress_allowlist.quote: macOS Tahoe Cloud Lite ... Unlimited Bandwidth
egress_allowlist.note: No provider-side outbound restriction/allowlist or no-internet mode is documented anywhere; bandwidth/egress is marketed as unrestricted ('Unlimited Bandwidth').

egress_http_rules.quote: macOS Tahoe Cloud Lite ... Unlimited Bandwidth
egress_http_rules.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a plain macOS VPS/dedicated host has no HTTP method/path-level egress control feature.

soc2.quote: The Company adheres to applicable data protection laws and ensures reasonable measures are taken to secure Customer data.
soc2.note: No trust/security/compliance page exists on the site; Terms of Service and Privacy Policy make no mention of SOC 2 or any third-party attestation. Small hosting company with no published compliance program.

hipaa.quote: The Company adheres to applicable data protection laws and ensures reasonable measures are taken to secure Customer data.
hipaa.note: No mention of HIPAA eligibility or a BAA anywhere on the site's legal/marketing pages.

sso.note: Customer account access is via a standard WHMCS username/password portal login; no SAML/OIDC single sign-on option is offered or mentioned.

eu_data_residency.quote: We provide users with macOS hosted cloud systems in our three amazing data centers located in Atlanta Georgia, Denver Colorado and Amsterdam The Netherlands.
eu_data_residency.note: Amsterdam, Netherlands is an EU location customers can pick, so machines/data can be kept in the EU.

max_session_h.quote: macOS Tahoe Cloud Lite / iMessage Package $24.99/mo Instant Activation ... Unlimited Bandwidth ... 24 Hour Support
max_session_h.note: These are always-on monthly-billed VPS/dedicated Mac servers (min_billed_seconds = one month in the card) with no session/runtime cap; the machine runs until stopped or cancelled, like a VM, not a time-boxed sandbox.

snapshot.quote: How do I backup the data from my macOS VPS or Dedicated Server? We recommend backing up your data using any number of popular services such as DropBox or Backblaze.
snapshot.note: No first-party snapshot/checkpoint product; only a support-ticket 'reset to original state' and third-party backup recommendations.

pause_resume.quote: If you need us to reboot your Mac Mini, just open a ticket and we can reboot it for you free of charge.
pause_resume.note: Only reboot is offered (via ticket or customer portal); VPS/dedicated are always-on monthly subscriptions with no pause/suspend billing state anywhere in FAQ, VPS or dedicated pages.

fork.quote: Can you reformat my macOS VPS Image? Yes! We can reset your VPS image back to it's original state at any time. For more information please submit a ticket.
fork.note: Only a reset-to-stock-image action exists; no cloning/duplicating a machine into new instances is offered anywhere on the site.

fork_running.quote: Can you reformat my macOS VPS Image? Yes! We can reset your VPS image back to it's original state at any time.
fork_running.note: No mention of cloning a live/running machine; the only machine-state operation exposed is reboot or ticket-based image reset.

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: We recommend backing up your data using any number of popular services such as DropBox or Backblaze.
memory_snapshot_fork.note: No snapshot feature of any kind (see snapshot=none), so a memory-included snapshot fork is not possible.

computer_use.quote: The are a number of tools available to allow you to control you Mac remotely. We recommend NoMachine, Apple Remote Desktop, or VNC. ... For those users that wish to connect via terminal, SSH is enabled on all servers by default.
computer_use.note: Only human-operated remote-desktop/SSH clients are offered; there is no API/SDK for an agent to drive the screen (no provisioning or agent API found anywhere on the site).

custom_image.quote: Can you reformat my macOS VPS Image? Yes! We can reset your VPS image back to it's original state at any time.
custom_image.note: Machines only reset to the provider's stock image via support ticket; there is no way to boot from or upload a custom image.

wake_on_request.quote: Monthly hosting ... commit_note: Monthly subscription, instant activation.
wake_on_request.note: VPS and dedicated Macs are always-on monthly-billed servers (min_billed_seconds = one month); no stopped/sleeping state exists for a request to wake from.

auto_stop_idle.quote: If you need us to reboot your Mac Mini, just open a ticket and we can reboot it for you free of charge.
auto_stop_idle.note: No idle-timeout stop/sleep behaviour is documented anywhere; machines run continuously for the whole monthly billing period.

volumes.note: doubtful "no" could not be confirmed: A prior audit note mentions an 'external NVMe SSD' monthly add-on for dedicated Mac minis, which would resemble an attachable persistent volume, but the relevant order-configuration pages are currently out of stock / unreachable (portal.hostmyapple.com cart items 39/41/43/57 all return 'Out of Stock') so no live official quote could be obtained this session. Left as unclear rather than corrected without a fresh source.

inbound_https.quote: Web Server A popular use, using the available Server.app you can host single or multiple w[ebsites]... Dedicated IP address
inbound_https.note: reviewed: proposed correction rejected (Every VPS/dedicated plan ships a dedicated public IPv4 with full root/admin access and an unrestricted guest firewall (pf, opened per the provider's own port-opening blog post); the provider explicitly markets running your own web server(s) on the box. That is sufficient to reach any port over HTTPS by pointing DNS at the dedicated IP and terminating TLS yourself, even though there's no managed HTTPS-proxy/URL product.)

agent_harnesses.quote: We recommend NoMachine, Apple Remote Desktop, or VNC. ... For those users that wish to connect via terminal, SSH is enabled on all servers by default.
agent_harnesses.note: No coding-agent harness (Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode/etc.) is preinstalled or offered as a template; this is a bare macOS VPS/dedicated server product aimed at human developers connecting over remote-desktop/SSH.

gpu.quote: Full admin privileges & GPU acceleration for intensive workloads ... Machine learning and AI development using TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Apple's Core ML. With GPU acceleration, process large datasets and train models efficiently in a macOS environment.
gpu.note: reviewed: proposed correction rejected (The provider explicitly advertises 'GPU acceleration' on dedicated Mac mini/Studio plans for ML workloads (TensorFlow/PyTorch/Core ML). This is the Apple Silicon chip's integrated GPU (no discrete/selectable GPU SKU, no gpu_types list, no separate GPU line item) rather than a dedicated NVIDIA/AMD compute GPU, but the product page does claim GPU-accelerated compute is available, so 'gpu: false' understates it.)

windows.quote: No Mac? No Problem! Use your Windows desktop to connect into a HostMyApple MacOS cloud server and gain instance access...
windows.note: The hosted machines are macOS only; Windows/Linux are only mentioned as the *client* device used to remotely connect to the macOS server, never as a guest OS offered.

self_host.quote: HostMyApple is a Mac Virtual Private Server (VPS) service. We provide users with a Mac OS X hosted system it in our amazing datacenter.
self_host.note: HostMyApple is purely a hosted service delivered from the vendor's own datacenter (Atlanta/Denver/Amsterdam); there is no software product a customer could install on their own infrastructure.

byoc.quote: HostMyApple is a Mac Virtual Private Server (VPS) service. We provide users with a Mac OS X hosted system it in our amazing datacenter.
byoc.note: Standard VPS/dedicated-hosting billing model (fixed monthly plans/sizes); no option to have HostMyApple deploy/manage the service inside a customer-owned cloud account.

open_source.note: HostMyApple is a proprietary, commercial hosting company (WHMCS customer portal, copyrighted site); no OSI-licensed core product exists.
